text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Four arrested for alleged vote-buying during agricultural union elections in Toufeng, northern Taiwan.
Tension between North and South Korea is on the rise as North Korean defector Li II-Man was shot and seriously wounded by two men suspected of being secret agents for Pyongyang.
Four detained for vote-buying allegations during agricultural union elections.
Former North Korean defector shot in the head, tension flares.
Taiwan and China to start direct marine links across the Taiwan Strait, but not direct cargo shipping, next month.
Chung Hwa Telecom to invest in Singapore's satellite communications project.
WTO global telecommunications liberalization agreement signed, 68 signatories agree to gradually liberalize their markets from 1998.
Taipei city government to sell government housing units, but not the land, to Taipei residents on a trial basis.
Fair Trade Commission considered revising constitution to abolish cooperatives and credit unions.
